method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: search_docs
tools.title: Search documentation
tools.description: Full-text search over the documentation. Returns matching sections with a snippet, the page path and heading anchor. Call get_doc with a returned path to read the full page or a single section.

query.description: Free-text query. Prefix matching and light fuzzy matching are applied per term.

path_prefix.description: Only search pages whose path starts with this prefix, e.g. "guides" or "api/reference".

tools.name: get_doc
tools.title: Get documentation page
tools.description: Return the full markdown of a documentation page by path, or a single section of it. Use search_docs or list_docs to find paths.

path.description: Page path from search_docs or list_docs, e.g. "guides/getting-started" (extensions and "docs://" prefix are accepted), or a full https:// URL to the page, optionally with a #fragment.

section.description: Return only this section: an anchor ("#install" or "install") or the heading text. Defaults to the #fragment of `path` when `path` is a URL.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.title: List documentation pages
tools.description: List documentation pages with their path, title, description and last-modified date. Useful to browse the structure before searching or to find pages under a prefix.

path_prefix.description: Only list pages under this path prefix.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to list.

tools.name: get_operation_context
tools.title: Get API operation request context
tools.description: Read one API operation: authentication, complete published request parameters and body requirements, plus a compact response envelope. Use an operation path from search_docs. Nested response schemas and code examples remain available through get_doc. Documentation only; does not verify connector coverage or execute requests.

path.description: Operation documentation path returned by search_docs, e.g. apis/hris/reference/employees/employeesAll
